test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of October 2020, who is the Chief Election Commissioner of India?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Sunil Arora.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Sunil Arora was the 23rd Chief Election Commissioner of India. 
 
• Sunil Arora is as well the chairman of the Association of **World Election Bodies (A-WEB).**
 
• He is a retired 1980-batch Indian Administrative Service (IAS) **officer of the Rajasthan **cadre.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ebd1574d91e49ed93d820f3173928cc0ee6a6ebd66312fb8b86aacc39f8b5cd.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Syed** Nasim** Ahmad** Zaidi served as the **20th** Chief Election Commissioner of India.​ 
 
• **Om Prakash Rawat** is a retired 1977 batch** Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer** of the Madhya Pradesh cadre as **22nd Chief Election Commissioner of India.**
 
• Achal Kumar Jyoti is a retired 1975 IAS officer of Gujarat cadre as** 21st Chief Election Commissioner of India.**
